They looked much like they could represent vertices of a five-pointed star.~And then I realized to what I was a witness: the legendary Stone of Castambre. Even had I not noticed the Tree of Life springing forth from the boulder, the Pentacle of rocks gave all away...	... 我很興奮！今天，我在主島上遇到了一棵樹。雖然這本身並不奇怪，但我注意到這棵樹似乎不是從地面上長出來的，而是從一塊大石頭上長出來的。同樣奇怪的是，五塊石頭圍繞著它，每塊石頭都與中心石頭和其他石頭保持相同的距離。它們看起來很像五點星的頂點。~然後我意識到我所見證的是什麼：傳說中的卡斯坦布雷石。即使我沒有注意到生命之樹從巨石上長出來，五顆石頭的五角星也給出了答案......
... I have been in this wretched place for more weeks than I care to remember -- than I COULD remember were I to try. I have seen far too much in the way of deception and falsehood. I am forced to wonder how this maze of tunnels can demonstrate Truth. There is one lesson I can claim to have learned, thou I wonder with whom I can ever share it: I am not the Avatar.
